NCPI MPs Seek Extension in TMC Disqualification Case

Two Members of Parliament (MPs) from the National Capital People's Initiative (NCPI), formerly associated with the Trinamool Congress (TMC), have requested a three-week extension to respond to a disqualification petition filed against them. The petition was lodged by the TMC. The MPs are seeking additional time to prepare their reply to the allegations made in the petition.
